Gangster Sanjay Singh, wanted in 26 cases, arrested in Patna

Sanjay Singh, a gangster and leader of the Pandav Sena, has been arrested in Patna by the Bihar Special Task Force (STF). Singh was reportedly on the run for a year and is wanted in connection with 26 cases. His arrest is a significant development in ongoing law enforcement efforts.
